query:
UPDATE runs
              SET ended_at = ?1, status = ?2, exit_class = ?3, error_message = ?4,
                  num_turns = ?5, cost_usd = ?6, pr_url = ?7,
                  model = ?8, effort = ?9, run_environment = ?10,
                  input_tokens = ?11, output_tokens = ?12,
                  cache_read_tokens = ?13, cache_creation_tokens = ?14
            WHERE id = ?15
